PokedexDescriptions.abra:
EVOLUTION: Kadabra — Lv16.

It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
PokedexDescriptions.alcremie: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
PokedexDescriptions.amaura:
EVOLUTION: Aurorus — Lv39 + night.

This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
PokedexDescriptions.anorith:
EVOLUTION: Armaldo — Lv40.

It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
PokedexDescriptions.applin:
EVOLUTION: Flapple — Lv30 + at Ginger West / Tart Apple; Appletun — Lv30 + at Farm / Sweet Apple; Dipplin — Lv30 + at Forest / Syrupy Apple.

It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
PokedexDescriptions.araquanid: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
PokedexDescriptions.ariados: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
PokedexDescriptions.aron:
EVOLUTION: Lairon — Lv32.

It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
PokedexDescriptions.bagon:
EVOLUTION: Shelgon — Lv30.

Its well-developed neck muscles and iron-like head can smash boulders into pieces.
PokedexDescriptions.bayleef:
EVOLUTION: Meganium — Lv32.

A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
PokedexDescriptions.beautifly: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.beldum:
EVOLUTION: Metang — Lv20.

The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
PokedexDescriptions.bellsprout:
EVOLUTION: Weepinbell — Lv21.

Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
PokedexDescriptions.bewear: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
PokedexDescriptions.bidoof:
EVOLUTION: Bibarel — Lv15.

With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
PokedexDescriptions.bisharp: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
PokedexDescriptions.bonsly:
EVOLUTION: Sudowoodo — knows Mimic.

It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
PokedexDescriptions.bounsweet:
EVOLUTION: Steenee — Lv18.

A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
PokedexDescriptions.braixen:
EVOLUTION: Delphox — Lv36.

It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
PokedexDescriptions.brionne:
EVOLUTION: Primarina — Lv34.

A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.budew:
EVOLUTION: Roselia — Bond80 + day.

When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
PokedexDescriptions.buizel: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
PokedexDescriptions.bulbasaur:
EVOLUTION: Ivysaur — Lv16.

A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.buneary:
EVOLUTION: Lopunny — Bond80.

Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
PokedexDescriptions.capsakid:
EVOLUTION: Scovillain — Lv30 / Fire Stone.

The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
PokedexDescriptions.cascoon:
EVOLUTION: Dustox — Lv10.

Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
PokedexDescriptions.caterpie:
EVOLUTION: Metapod — Lv7.

For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.chansey:
EVOLUTION: Blissey — Bond120.

It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
PokedexDescriptions.charcadet:
EVOLUTION: Armarouge — Lv30 + day / Auspicious Armor; Ceruledge — Lv30 + night / Malicious Armor.

Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
PokedexDescriptions.charmander:
EVOLUTION: Charmeleon — Lv16.

The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
PokedexDescriptions.charmeleon:
EVOLUTION: Charizard — Lv36.

It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
PokedexDescriptions.cherrim: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
PokedexDescriptions.cherubi:
EVOLUTION: Cherrim — Lv25.

Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.chespin:
EVOLUTION: Quilladin — Lv16.

The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
PokedexDescriptions.chikorita:
EVOLUTION: Bayleef — Lv16.

A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.
PokedexDescriptions.chimchar:
EVOLUTION: Monferno — Lv14.

Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
PokedexDescriptions.clauncher:
EVOLUTION: Clawitzer — Lv37.

They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
PokedexDescriptions.clefairy:
EVOLUTION: Clefable — Lv20 / Moon Stone.

It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
PokedexDescriptions.cleffa:
EVOLUTION: Clefairy — Bond80.

Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
PokedexDescriptions.clobbopus:
EVOLUTION: Grapploct — knows Taunt.

It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
PokedexDescriptions.combee:
EVOLUTION: Vespiquen — Lv21 + Female.

The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
PokedexDescriptions.combusken:
EVOLUTION: Blaziken — Lv36.

Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
PokedexDescriptions.corviknight: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
PokedexDescriptions.corvisquire: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.cranidos:
EVOLUTION: Rampardos — Lv30.

It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
PokedexDescriptions.crocalor:
EVOLUTION: Skeledirge — Lv36.

The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
PokedexDescriptions.croconaw:
EVOLUTION: Feraligatr — Lv30.

If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.cubone:
EVOLUTION: Marowak — Lv28.

It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
PokedexDescriptions.cyndaquil:
EVOLUTION: Quilava — Lv14.

It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.dartrix:
EVOLUTION: Decidueye — Lv34.

A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
PokedexDescriptions.deerling:
EVOLUTION: Sawsbuck — Lv34.

Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
PokedexDescriptions.deino:
EVOLUTION: Zweilous — Lv50.

They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
PokedexDescriptions.dewott:
EVOLUTION: Samurott — Lv36.

Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
PokedexDescriptions.dewpider:
EVOLUTION: Araquanid — Lv22.

It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
PokedexDescriptions.diglett:
EVOLUTION: Dugtrio — Lv26.

Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
PokedexDescriptions.dipplin:
EVOLUTION: Hydrapple — knows Dragon Cheer.

Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
PokedexDescriptions.doduo:
EVOLUTION: Dodrio — Lv31.

A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
PokedexDescriptions.dragalge: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
PokedexDescriptions.dragonair:
EVOLUTION: Dragonite — Lv55.

Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
PokedexDescriptions.drampa: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
PokedexDescriptions.drapion: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
PokedexDescriptions.dratini:
EVOLUTION: Dragonair — Lv30.

It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
PokedexDescriptions.drilbur:
EVOLUTION: Excadrill — Lv31.

It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.drizzile:
EVOLUTION: Inteleon — Lv35.

A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
PokedexDescriptions.drowzee:
EVOLUTION: Hypno — Lv26.

Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
PokedexDescriptions.duosion:
EVOLUTION: Reuniclus — Lv41.

Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
PokedexDescriptions.dustox: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
PokedexDescriptions.eevee: EVOLUTION: Vaporeon — Lv20 + at Beach / Water Stone; Jolteon — Lv20 + at Railroad / Thunder Stone; Flareon — Lv20 + at Desert / Fire Stone; Sylveon — Bond120 + Fairy Move equipped; Espeon — Bond120 + day; Umbreon — Bond120 + night; Leafeon — Lv20 + at Forest / Leaf Stone; Glaceon — Lv20 + at Mountain / Ice Stone.
PokedexDescriptions.ekans:
EVOLUTION: Arbok — Lv22.

The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
PokedexDescriptions.electabuzz:
EVOLUTION: Electivire — Lv42 / Electirizer.

Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.
PokedexDescriptions.elekid:
EVOLUTION: Electabuzz — Lv30.

It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
PokedexDescriptions.exeggcute:
EVOLUTION: Exeggutor — (Lv20 / Leaf Stone) outside Beach/Ginger; Alolan Exeggutor — (Lv20 / Leaf Stone) @ Beach/Ginger.

Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
PokedexDescriptions.exploud: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
PokedexDescriptions.feebas:
EVOLUTION: Milotic — Lv30 + Bond80 / Prism Scale.

It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.
PokedexDescriptions.fennekin:
EVOLUTION: Braixen — Lv16.

Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.fidough:
EVOLUTION: Dachsbun — Lv26.

This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
PokedexDescriptions.flaaffy:
EVOLUTION: Ampharos — Lv30.

Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
PokedexDescriptions.flabebe:
EVOLUTION: Floette — Lv19.

It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
PokedexDescriptions.floatzel: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
PokedexDescriptions.floette:
EVOLUTION: Florges — Lv32 / Shiny Stone.

It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
PokedexDescriptions.floragato:
EVOLUTION: Meowscarada — Lv36.

Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
PokedexDescriptions.froakie:
EVOLUTION: Frogadier — Lv16.

It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
PokedexDescriptions.frogadier:
EVOLUTION: Greninja — Lv36.

It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
PokedexDescriptions.fuecoco:
EVOLUTION: Crocalor — Lv16.

It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
PokedexDescriptions.furfrou: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
PokedexDescriptions.gabite:
EVOLUTION: Garchomp — Lv48.

It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
PokedexDescriptions.gastly:
EVOLUTION: Haunter — Lv25.

Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
PokedexDescriptions.geodude:
EVOLUTION: Graveler — Lv25.

Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
PokedexDescriptions.gible:
EVOLUTION: Gabite — Lv24.

It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
PokedexDescriptions.girafarig:
EVOLUTION: Farigiraf — knows Twin Beam.

While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.glameow:
EVOLUTION: Purugly — Lv38.

It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
PokedexDescriptions.gloom:
EVOLUTION: Vileplume — Lv32 / Leaf Stone; Bellossom — Lv32 + day / Sun Stone.

Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
PokedexDescriptions.golbat:
EVOLUTION: Crobat — Bond120.

Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
PokedexDescriptions.goldeen:
EVOLUTION: Seaking — Lv33.

It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
PokedexDescriptions.golett:
EVOLUTION: Golurk — Lv43.

The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
PokedexDescriptions.goomy:
EVOLUTION: Sliggoo — Lv40.

The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
PokedexDescriptions.gossifleur:
EVOLUTION: Eldegoss — Lv20.

It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
PokedexDescriptions.gothita:
EVOLUTION: Gothorita — Lv32.

Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
PokedexDescriptions.gothorita:
EVOLUTION: Gothitelle — Lv41.

Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
PokedexDescriptions.graveler:
EVOLUTION: Golem — Lv32 / Trade.

With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
PokedexDescriptions.greavard:
EVOLUTION: Houndstone — Lv30 + night.

It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.grimer:
EVOLUTION: Muk — Lv38.

Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
PokedexDescriptions.grookey:
EVOLUTION: Thwackey — Lv16.

When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
PokedexDescriptions.grotle:
EVOLUTION: Torterra — Lv32.

It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
PokedexDescriptions.grovyle:
EVOLUTION: Sceptile — Lv36.

Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
PokedexDescriptions.growlithe:
EVOLUTION: Arcanine — Lv20 / Fire Stone.

Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
PokedexDescriptions.happiny:
EVOLUTION: Chansey — Bond80 + day / Oval Stone + day.

It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
PokedexDescriptions.haunter:
EVOLUTION: Gengar — Lv32 / Trade.

If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
PokedexDescriptions.herdier:
EVOLUTION: Stoutland — Lv32.

This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-sneasel:
EVOLUTION: Sneasler — Lv30 + day.

Its sturdy claws and poison adapted to harsh highlands, where it scales steep cliffs with ease.
PokedexDescriptions.hoothoot:
EVOLUTION: Noctowl — Lv20.

It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
PokedexDescriptions.horsea:
EVOLUTION: Seadra — Lv32.

Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
PokedexDescriptions.houndour:
EVOLUTION: Houndoom — Lv24.

Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.
PokedexDescriptions.houndstone: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
PokedexDescriptions.impidimp:
EVOLUTION: Morgrem — Lv32.

Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
PokedexDescriptions.inkay:
EVOLUTION: Malamar — Lv30.

Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
PokedexDescriptions.ivysaur:
EVOLUTION: Venusaur — Lv32.

There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
PokedexDescriptions.jigglypuff:
EVOLUTION: Wigglytuff — Lv20 / Moon Stone.

It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
PokedexDescriptions.kabuto:
EVOLUTION: Kabutops — Lv40.

It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
PokedexDescriptions.kadabra:
EVOLUTION: Alakazam — Lv32 / Trade.

When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
PokedexDescriptions.kakuna:
EVOLUTION: Beedrill — Lv10.

Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
PokedexDescriptions.kingambit: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
PokedexDescriptions.kirlia:
EVOLUTION: Gardevoir — Lv30; Gallade — Lv30 + Male / Dawn Stone + Male.

The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
PokedexDescriptions.koffing:
EVOLUTION: Weezing — Lv35.

Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
PokedexDescriptions.krabby:
EVOLUTION: Kingler — Lv28.

If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
PokedexDescriptions.krokorok:
EVOLUTION: Krookodile — Lv40.

They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
PokedexDescriptions.lairon:
EVOLUTION: Aggron — Lv42.

It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
PokedexDescriptions.lampent:
EVOLUTION: Chandelure — Lv50 / Dusk Stone.

The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
PokedexDescriptions.larvesta:
EVOLUTION: Volcarona — Lv59.

Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
PokedexDescriptions.larvitar:
EVOLUTION: Pupitar — Lv30.

It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.
PokedexDescriptions.leavanny: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.lickitung:
EVOLUTION: Lickilicky — knows Rollout.

Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
PokedexDescriptions.lileep:
EVOLUTION: Cradily — Lv40.

It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
PokedexDescriptions.lillipup:
EVOLUTION: Herdier — Lv16.

The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
PokedexDescriptions.linoone: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
PokedexDescriptions.litten:
EVOLUTION: Torracat — Lv17.

While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
PokedexDescriptions.litwick:
EVOLUTION: Lampent — Lv41.

While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
PokedexDescriptions.lombre:
EVOLUTION: Ludicolo — Lv30.

It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.lotad:
EVOLUTION: Lombre — Lv14.

It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
PokedexDescriptions.loudred:
EVOLUTION: Exploud — Lv40.

It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
PokedexDescriptions.luxio:
EVOLUTION: Luxray — Lv30.

Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
PokedexDescriptions.machoke:
EVOLUTION: Machamp — Lv32 / Trade.

Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
PokedexDescriptions.machop:
EVOLUTION: Machoke — Lv28.

It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
PokedexDescriptions.magby:
EVOLUTION: Magmar — Lv30.

It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.
PokedexDescriptions.magikarp:
EVOLUTION: Gyarados — Lv20.

It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
PokedexDescriptions.magmar:
EVOLUTION: Magmortar — Lv42 / Magmarizer.

Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.magnemite:
EVOLUTION: Magneton — Lv30.

The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
PokedexDescriptions.magneton:
EVOLUTION: Magnezone — Lv42 + at Mountain / Thunder Stone.

A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
PokedexDescriptions.mankey:
EVOLUTION: Primeape — Lv28.

It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
PokedexDescriptions.mareanie:
EVOLUTION: Toxapex — Lv38.

It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
PokedexDescriptions.mareep:
EVOLUTION: Flaaffy — Lv15.

Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
PokedexDescriptions.marshtomp:
EVOLUTION: Swampert — Lv36.

Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.meowth:
EVOLUTION: Persian — Lv28.

It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
PokedexDescriptions.metang:
EVOLUTION: Metagross — Lv45.

It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
PokedexDescriptions.metapod:
EVOLUTION: Butterfree — Lv10.

A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.milcery:
EVOLUTION: Alcremie — Prismatic Shard.

This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
PokedexDescriptions.mime-jr:
EVOLUTION: Mr. Mime — knows Mimic.

In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
PokedexDescriptions.minccino:
EVOLUTION: Cinccino — Lv25 / Shiny Stone.

Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
PokedexDescriptions.monferno:
EVOLUTION: Infernape — Lv36.

It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
PokedexDescriptions.morgrem:
EVOLUTION: Grimmsnarl — Lv42.

When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
PokedexDescriptions.mudkip:
EVOLUTION: Marshtomp — Lv16.

Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
PokedexDescriptions.munchlax:
EVOLUTION: Snorlax — Bond100.

It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
PokedexDescriptions.munna:
EVOLUTION: Musharna — Lv28 + Bond80 / Moon Stone.

This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
PokedexDescriptions.murkrow:
EVOLUTION: Honchkrow — Lv30 + night / Dusk Stone.

It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another’s stashes.
PokedexDescriptions.nacli:
EVOLUTION: Naclstack — Lv24.

It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
PokedexDescriptions.naclstack:
EVOLUTION: Garganacl — Lv38.

This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoran-f:
EVOLUTION: Nidorina — Lv16.

Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoran-m:
EVOLUTION: Nidorino — Lv16.

It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.nidorina:
EVOLUTION: Nidoqueen — Lv32 / Moon Stone.

The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.
PokedexDescriptions.nidorino:
EVOLUTION: Nidoking — Lv32 / Moon Stone.

It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
PokedexDescriptions.noibat:
EVOLUTION: Noivern — Lv48.

They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
PokedexDescriptions.numel:
EVOLUTION: Camerupt — Lv33.

Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
PokedexDescriptions.nymble:
EVOLUTION: Lokix — Lv24.

It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
PokedexDescriptions.oddish:
EVOLUTION: Gloom — Lv21.

During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
PokedexDescriptions.omanyte:
EVOLUTION: Omastar — Lv40.

A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
PokedexDescriptions.onix:
EVOLUTION: Steelix — Lv40 / Metal Coat.

Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
PokedexDescriptions.oshawott:
EVOLUTION: Dewott — Lv17.

The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
PokedexDescriptions.paldean-wooper:
EVOLUTION: Clodsire — Lv20.

After losing a struggle for territory, it adapted to life on land. A poisonous film protects its body from drying out.
PokedexDescriptions.palpitoad:
EVOLUTION: Seismitoad — Lv36.

When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
PokedexDescriptions.pancham:
EVOLUTION: Pangoro — Lv32.

It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
PokedexDescriptions.pansage:
EVOLUTION: Simisage — Lv28 / Leaf Stone.

It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
PokedexDescriptions.paras:
EVOLUTION: Parasect — Lv24.

Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
PokedexDescriptions.pawniard: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
PokedexDescriptions.petilil:
EVOLUTION: Lilligant — Lv28 / Leaf Stone.

The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
PokedexDescriptions.phantump:
EVOLUTION: Trevenant — Lv30 / Trade.

These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
PokedexDescriptions.pichu:
EVOLUTION: Pikachu — Bond80.

It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
PokedexDescriptions.pidgeotto:
EVOLUTION: Pidgeot — Lv36.

The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
PokedexDescriptions.pidgey:
EVOLUTION: Pidgeotto — Lv18.

A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
PokedexDescriptions.pignite:
EVOLUTION: Emboar — Lv36.

The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
PokedexDescriptions.pikachu:
EVOLUTION: Raichu — (Lv20 / Thunder Stone) outside Beach/Ginger; Alolan Raichu — (Lv20 / Thunder Stone) @ Beach/Ginger.

It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
PokedexDescriptions.piplup:
EVOLUTION: Prinplup — Lv16.

It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
PokedexDescriptions.poliwag:
EVOLUTION: Poliwhirl — Lv25.

Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
PokedexDescriptions.poliwhirl:
EVOLUTION: Poliwrath — Lv32 + at Mountain / Water Stone; Politoed — Lv32 + rain + at Forest / King's Rock.

It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
PokedexDescriptions.ponyta:
EVOLUTION: Rapidash — Lv40.

As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
PokedexDescriptions.poochyena:
EVOLUTION: Mightyena — Lv18.

A tenacious Pokémon that chases prey until it becomes exhausted.
PokedexDescriptions.popplio:
EVOLUTION: Brionne — Lv17.

This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
PokedexDescriptions.porygon:
EVOLUTION: Porygon2 — Lv30 / Up-Grade.

A man-made Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.
PokedexDescriptions.porygon2:
EVOLUTION: Porygon Z — Lv40 / Dubious Disc.

Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
PokedexDescriptions.primeape:
EVOLUTION: Annihilape — knows Rage Fist.

It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
PokedexDescriptions.prinplup:
EVOLUTION: Empoleon — Lv36.

It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
PokedexDescriptions.psyduck:
EVOLUTION: Golduck — Lv33.

It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
PokedexDescriptions.pumpkaboo:
EVOLUTION: Gourgeist — Lv30 / Trade.

The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
PokedexDescriptions.pupitar:
EVOLUTION: Tyranitar — Lv55.

Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
PokedexDescriptions.quaxly:
EVOLUTION: Quaxwell — Lv16.

This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
PokedexDescriptions.quaxwell:
EVOLUTION: Quaquaval — Lv36.

These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
PokedexDescriptions.quilava:
EVOLUTION: Typhlosion — Lv36.

Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
PokedexDescriptions.quilladin:
EVOLUTION: Chesnaught — Lv36.

It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
PokedexDescriptions.raboot:
EVOLUTION: Cinderace — Lv35.

Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
PokedexDescriptions.ralts:
EVOLUTION: Kirlia — Lv20.

If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
PokedexDescriptions.rattata:
EVOLUTION: Raticate — Lv20.

Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
PokedexDescriptions.revavroom: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
PokedexDescriptions.rhydon:
EVOLUTION: Rhyperior — Lv42 / Protector.

Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.rhyhorn:
EVOLUTION: Rhydon — Lv42.

Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
PokedexDescriptions.riolu:
EVOLUTION: Lucario — Bond100 + day.

It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
PokedexDescriptions.rookidee: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
PokedexDescriptions.roselia:
EVOLUTION: Roserade — Lv32 + day / Shiny Stone.

It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
PokedexDescriptions.rowlet:
EVOLUTION: Dartrix — Lv17.

This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.salandit:
EVOLUTION: Salazzle — Lv33 + Female.

It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
PokedexDescriptions.sandile:
EVOLUTION: Krokorok — Lv29.

It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
PokedexDescriptions.sandshrew:
EVOLUTION: Sandslash — Lv22.

It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.scatterbug:
EVOLUTION: Spewpa — Lv9.

When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
PokedexDescriptions.scorbunny:
EVOLUTION: Raboot — Lv16.

A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
PokedexDescriptions.scrafty: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
PokedexDescriptions.scraggy:
EVOLUTION: Scrafty — Lv39.

Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
PokedexDescriptions.scyther:
EVOLUTION: Scizor — Lv42 + at Railroad / Metal Coat; Kleavor — Lv42 + at Mountain / Black Augurite.

It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
PokedexDescriptions.seadra:
EVOLUTION: Kingdra — Lv40 / Dragon Scale.

Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
PokedexDescriptions.sealeo:
EVOLUTION: Walrein — Lv44.

It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
PokedexDescriptions.seel:
EVOLUTION: Dewgong — Lv34.

A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
PokedexDescriptions.sentret:
EVOLUTION: Furret — Lv15.

When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.servine:
EVOLUTION: Serperior — Lv36.

It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
PokedexDescriptions.sewaddle:
EVOLUTION: Swadloon — Lv20.

This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.shelgon:
EVOLUTION: Salamence — Lv50.

Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
PokedexDescriptions.shellder:
EVOLUTION: Cloyster — Lv20 / Water Stone.

Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
PokedexDescriptions.shellos:
EVOLUTION: Gastrodon — Lv30.

Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
PokedexDescriptions.shieldon:
EVOLUTION: Bastiodon — Lv30.

It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
PokedexDescriptions.shinx:
EVOLUTION: Luxio — Lv15.

The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
PokedexDescriptions.shroomish:
EVOLUTION: Breloom — Lv23.

It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
PokedexDescriptions.shuppet:
EVOLUTION: Banette — Lv37.

It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-- or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.silcoon:
EVOLUTION: Beautifly — Lv10.

It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.sinistea:
EVOLUTION: Polteageist — Lv32 / Cracked Pot / Chipped Pot.

This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
PokedexDescriptions.skarmory: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
PokedexDescriptions.skiddo:
EVOLUTION: Gogoat — Lv32.

Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
PokedexDescriptions.skitty:
EVOLUTION: Delcatty — Lv28 / Moon Stone.

It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
PokedexDescriptions.skorupi:
EVOLUTION: Drapion — Lv40.

It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
PokedexDescriptions.skrelp:
EVOLUTION: Dragalge — Lv48.

Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
PokedexDescriptions.skuntank: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
PokedexDescriptions.sliggoo:
EVOLUTION: Goodra — Lv50 + rain.

It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
PokedexDescriptions.slowpoke:
EVOLUTION: Slowbro — Lv20 + day; Slowking — Lv20 + night / King's Rock.

It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.smoochum:
EVOLUTION: Jynx — Lv30.

Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
PokedexDescriptions.sneasel:
EVOLUTION: Weavile — Lv30 + night / Razor Claw + night.

It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
PokedexDescriptions.sneasler: Its long claws carry a potent poison, and its strength lets it race freely across sheer mountain walls.
PokedexDescriptions.snivy:
EVOLUTION: Servine — Lv17.

Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
PokedexDescriptions.snom:
EVOLUTION: Frosmoth — Bond80 + night.

It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
PokedexDescriptions.snorunt:
EVOLUTION: Glalie — Lv42; Froslass — Lv42 + Female / Dawn Stone + Female.

It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
PokedexDescriptions.snover:
EVOLUTION: Abomasnow — Lv40.

During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
PokedexDescriptions.sobble:
EVOLUTION: Drizzile — Lv16.

When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
PokedexDescriptions.solosis:
EVOLUTION: Duosion — Lv32.

Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
PokedexDescriptions.spearow:
EVOLUTION: Fearow — Lv20.

Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.spewpa:
EVOLUTION: Vivillon — Lv12.

It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
PokedexDescriptions.spheal:
EVOLUTION: Sealeo — Lv32.

They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
PokedexDescriptions.spinarak:
EVOLUTION: Ariados — Lv22.

It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
PokedexDescriptions.sprigatito:
EVOLUTION: Floragato — Lv16.

Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
PokedexDescriptions.squirtle:
EVOLUTION: Wartortle — Lv16.

It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
PokedexDescriptions.stantler:
EVOLUTION: Wyrdeer — knows Psyshield Bash.

Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
PokedexDescriptions.staryu:
EVOLUTION: Starmie — Lv20 / Water Stone.

Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
PokedexDescriptions.steenee:
EVOLUTION: Tsareena — knows Stomp.

The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
PokedexDescriptions.stufful:
EVOLUTION: Bewear — Lv27.

Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
PokedexDescriptions.stunky:
EVOLUTION: Skuntank — Lv34.

It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
PokedexDescriptions.swablu:
EVOLUTION: Altaria — Lv35.

For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
PokedexDescriptions.swadloon:
EVOLUTION: Leavanny — Lv29.

Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
PokedexDescriptions.tadbulb:
EVOLUTION: Bellibolt — Lv25 / Thunder Stone.

Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
PokedexDescriptions.taillow:
EVOLUTION: Swellow — Lv22.

It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
PokedexDescriptions.tangela:
EVOLUTION: Tangrowth — knows Ancient Power.

Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
PokedexDescriptions.tarountula:
EVOLUTION: Spidops — Lv15.

The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
PokedexDescriptions.teddiursa:
EVOLUTION: Ursaring — Lv30.

If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
PokedexDescriptions.tentacool:
EVOLUTION: Tentacruel — Lv30.

Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
PokedexDescriptions.tepig:
EVOLUTION: Pignite — Lv17.

It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
PokedexDescriptions.thwackey:
EVOLUTION: Rillaboom — Lv35.

The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
PokedexDescriptions.tinkatink:
EVOLUTION: Tinkatuff — Lv24.

It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
PokedexDescriptions.tinkatuff:
EVOLUTION: Tinkaton — Lv38.

This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
PokedexDescriptions.togepi:
EVOLUTION: Togetic — Bond80.

The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
PokedexDescriptions.togetic:
EVOLUTION: Togekiss — Lv32 + Bond120 / Shiny Stone.

It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
PokedexDescriptions.torchic:
EVOLUTION: Combusken — Lv16.

It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
PokedexDescriptions.torracat:
EVOLUTION: Incineroar — Lv34.

At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
PokedexDescriptions.totodile:
EVOLUTION: Croconaw — Lv18.

It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
PokedexDescriptions.toxel:
EVOLUTION: Toxtricity — Lv30.

It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
PokedexDescriptions.trapinch:
EVOLUTION: Vibrava — Lv35.

It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
PokedexDescriptions.treecko:
EVOLUTION: Grovyle — Lv16.

It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
PokedexDescriptions.trubbish:
EVOLUTION: Garbodor — Lv36.

The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.tsareena: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
PokedexDescriptions.turtwig:
EVOLUTION: Grotle — Lv18.

Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
PokedexDescriptions.tympole:
EVOLUTION: Palpitoad — Lv25.

By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
PokedexDescriptions.tyrogue:
EVOLUTION: Hitmonlee — Lv20 + Attack > Defense; Hitmonchan — Lv20 + Attack < Defense; Hitmontop — Lv20 + Attack = Defense.

It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
PokedexDescriptions.tyrunt:
EVOLUTION: Tyrantrum — Lv39 + day.

This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
PokedexDescriptions.ursaluna: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
PokedexDescriptions.ursaring:
EVOLUTION: Ursaluna — Lv45 + night.

With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
PokedexDescriptions.varoom:
EVOLUTION: Revavroom — Lv40.

It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
PokedexDescriptions.venipede:
EVOLUTION: Whirlipede — Lv22.

It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
PokedexDescriptions.venonat:
EVOLUTION: Venomoth — Lv31.

Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
PokedexDescriptions.vibrava:
EVOLUTION: Flygon — Lv45.

The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
PokedexDescriptions.vivillon: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
PokedexDescriptions.volcarona: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
PokedexDescriptions.voltorb:
EVOLUTION: Electrode — Lv30.

It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
PokedexDescriptions.vulpix:
EVOLUTION: Ninetales — Lv20 / Fire Stone.

When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
PokedexDescriptions.wartortle:
EVOLUTION: Blastoise — Lv36.

When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
PokedexDescriptions.weedle:
EVOLUTION: Kakuna — Lv7.

Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
PokedexDescriptions.weepinbell:
EVOLUTION: Victreebel — Lv32 / Leaf Stone.

The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
PokedexDescriptions.whirlipede:
EVOLUTION: Scolipede — Lv30.

Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.whismur:
EVOLUTION: Loudred — Lv20.

It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
PokedexDescriptions.wingull:
EVOLUTION: Pelipper — Lv25.

Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.
PokedexDescriptions.woobat:
EVOLUTION: Swoobat — Bond80.

Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
PokedexDescriptions.wooloo:
EVOLUTION: Dubwool — Lv24.

Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
PokedexDescriptions.wooper:
EVOLUTION: Quagsire — Lv20.

This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
PokedexDescriptions.wurmple:
EVOLUTIONS: Silcoon — Lv7; Cascoon — Lv7.

It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
PokedexDescriptions.yanma:
EVOLUTION: Yanmega — knows Ancient Power.

Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
PokedexDescriptions.zigzagoon:
EVOLUTION: Linoone — Lv20.

It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
PokedexDescriptions.zorua:
EVOLUTION: Zoroark — Lv30.

It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
PokedexDescriptions.zubat:
EVOLUTION: Golbat — Lv22.

Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.zweilous:
EVOLUTION: Hydreigon — Lv64.

The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
